canDoYue: 你識講櫃員機食咗張卡、而家凍結呢張卡、出示一份身份文件、星期五收新卡，同埋一個工作日嘅臨時限額。
canDoEn: Say the machine kept the card, freeze that card now, show one identity document, and ask about a temporary limit that lasts one working day, with the new card on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The cash machine kept my card.
dialogue.glossYue: 櫃員機食咗我張卡，我完全攞唔出嚟。
dialogue.say: The cash machine kept my card.

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: I am sorry the machine kept the card. Did you try the cancel button on the screen first?
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思，部機食咗張卡。你試過畫面上面個取消掣未？
dialogue.say: I am sorry the machine kept the card. Did you try the cancel button on the screen first?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Yes, I tried the cancel button, and the machine still kept the card inside the slot.
dialogue.glossYue: 試過取消掣，部機仍然將張卡食喺插槽入面。
dialogue.say: Yes, I tried the cancel button, and the machine still kept the card inside the slot.

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: We can freeze this one card right now, and the new card arrives on Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋而家可以凍結呢一張卡，新卡星期五到。
dialogue.say: We can freeze this one card right now, and the new card arrives on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: What papers prove my identity at this desk, and when does the new card arrive?
dialogue.glossYue: 喺呢個櫃檯要用咩文件證明身份，新卡幾時到？
dialogue.say: What papers prove my identity at this desk, and when does the new card arrive?

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: Please show one identity document to me, and the new card arrives on Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 請畀一份身份文件我睇，新卡星期五到。
dialogue.say: Please show one identity document to me, and the new card arrives on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I draw some cash at this counter on the temporary limit while I wait?
dialogue.glossYue: 我等緊嘅時候，可唔可以用臨時限額喺櫃檯拎現金？
dialogue.say: Can I draw some cash at this counter on the temporary limit while I wait?

dialogue.speaker: ben
dialogue.text: The temporary limit is two thousand dollars, and it lasts for one working day.
dialogue.glossYue: 臨時限額係二千蚊，維持一個工作日。
dialogue.say: The temporary limit is two thousand dollars, and it lasts for one working day.
